verdict.rationale: Figma's Dev Mode (figma-docs-64) and separately licensed 'Advanced Dev Mode inspection' tier (figma-docs-23) plus Code Connect's true-to-production code snippets (figma-gh-1) support inspecting layers and generating code without a full editor seat, and community confirms Dev Mode is now a distinct (non-editor) license (figma-comm-4). However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm iOS/Android snippet output (only CSS is discussed) and community feedback flags friction in asset/SVG export and CSS quality (figma-comm-1, figma-comm-2), showing real workflow gaps. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-platform (iOS/Android) code snippet generation, and confirmation that asset export/inspection is seamless without extra plugins.
